name: Clockwork Arms AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale
description: Four claw-tipped clockwork arms suspended from the ceiling pick up and deposit creatures into a nearby hatch.
disable: DC 43 Thievery (master) to jam and deactivate one of the arms or DC 46 Athletics (legendary) to tear an arm off the machine.
routine: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action per arm destroyed or disabled. On its turn, the trap makes claw Strikes against creatures other than the Rumormonger or the Inkmaster. If an arm already has a creature grabbed, the trap spends 2 actions to use its Open Hatch ability.

generalAbilities.name: Arm Activation
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The Rumormonger or the Inkmaster enters the room

Effect The trap rolls initiative.

generalAbilities.name: Open Hatch
generalAbilities.description: The metal hatch opens and the arms deposit a grabbed Medium or smaller creature into the hole. The creature becomes caught in the gears (see Caught in Gears) for 1 round before emerging in area K5. Reset Rewinding the gears for 1d4 minutes resets the trap.
